name: Test Flake
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
    paths:
      - "flake.nix"
      - "flake.lock"
      - ".github/workflows/test-flake.yml"
      - "rust-toolchain.toml"
      - "Cargo.toml"
      - "Cargo.lock"
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "flake.nix"
      - "flake.lock"
      - ".github/workflows/test-flake.yml"
      - "rust-toolchain.toml"
      - "Cargo.toml"
      - "Cargo.lock"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-flake:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Nix
        uses: DeterminateSystems/nix-installer-action@v13

      - name: Install magic Nix cache
        uses: DeterminateSystems/magic-nix-cache-action@v8

      - name: Test flake
        run: |
          nix flake check
          nix develop --accept-flake-config -c true
